6871.title: Model discovery accepts configuration without confirming its model
6871.rootCauseOneLine: ACP discovery keys reasoning and service-tier support by the requested model without checking the model identified in the reply.
6871.proposedFix: Require a matching reply model before recording support, retry once, and retain unknown support if identity remains unverifiable.
6871.caveats: The real bridge was exercised with a deterministic repository-owned ACP subprocess; external agent race frequency was not measured. Reproduction patch and output are inline, per reports repository policy.
